scope: Randomized variants of the two spells a live request reached that Rust refused. Challenging Shout: a Protection Warrior tanking 1, 3 and 5 targets, an Arms Warrior against 1, 3 and 5 and a Fury Warrior against 1, 2 and 5, plus the 4 accepted Warrior fixtures. Demoralizing Roar: a Feral Bear tanking and not tanking and a Feral Cat whose rotation names the roar, each against 1, 3 and 5 targets with no raid debuff, the raid's permanent Demoralizing Shout debuff and its permanent Demoralizing Roar debuff, plus the 15 accepted Druid fixtures; and a Protection Warrior's Demoralizing Shout asking auraShouldRefresh of the same category against 1 and 3 targets under the same three debuffs. 208 variants of 61 requests at 200 iterations, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. Each variant draws its race from the races of its class, and a row that names a raid debuff keeps it in every variant.
generator: python3 tools/shout_roar_sweep.py --output <scratch>, which draws the variants of tools/sweep.py (seed 20261010 plus the row's position, 200 iterations, melee range) from the accepted requests with Challenging Shout or Demoralizing Roar added to the rotation, 3 to 5 variants of each request and fixture; each variant <scratch>/NAME-sweep-NN.request.json is compared as variants/NAME-sweep-NN.request.json

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every variant matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log. All 55 Challenging Shout variants cast it in the first fight, 33 of them against several targets, where it hits each in unit index order for no damage and no threat. Of the 81 Bear variants (54 tanking, 27 not) the 21 with no raid debuff roar in the first fight and the 60 under a permanent Demoralizing Shout or Roar debuff never do, since the debuff bids the same attack power cut and outlasts any refresh window, which the runtime reads from the exported category. None of the 54 Cat variants casts the roar, which a cat never learns: Go drops the cast and its condition. Of the 18 Warrior shout variants that ask auraShouldRefresh, the 6 with no raid debuff cast it and the 12 under a permanent debuff do not.
